rule: A question in 'easier' is skipped once the latest attempt on anything in 'harder' passed (85%): the harder one already does the easier one's work, plus more steps. Refs are a node id, or node#variantId for one variant. Hand-authored; tests/supersedes.test.mjs checks every ref exists and nothing loops.

pairs.why: Deriving the terms by the microstate table means counting the microstates first.
CFSE for d1-d3 and the high/low-spin d5, d6, d9 cases are rows of the full CFSE table (and of the past-paper chain's last step).
The past-paper chain goes name, oxidation state, dn, geometry, splitting and CFSE: it contains the oxidation-state and dn questions.
Oxidation state alone, or dn alone, is part of the oxidation state + dn + coordination number question.
The full d7 and d4 questions ask for the ground-state term and the spin of the high- and low-spin forms, which is the guided ground-state step.
State all spin-allowed transitions for high and low spin is the guided 'spin-allowed bands, in order' step with both spin states.
The d7 diagram question asks for the spin-only moment of the high- and low-spin forms.
